findings.description: Nicolasa Cedillo (GJG6-F2L) died on 12 February 1945, registered 13 February 1945, at Santa Lucía, Intibucá, Honduras. The civil death registration indexes her parents as Ventura Cedillo and María Jesús Amaya (birth about 1875), which matches the subject's established parentage. FamilySearch's hinted 1943 death at Santa Lucía (Ma Nicolasa Cedillo, registered 22 May 1943, spouse Santiago Cedillo, mother indexed as Julia Cedillo) is a different, same-named woman, not the subject.
